goal: Make scanblocks return an error when reading block filters fails instead of silently skipping blocks
Prevents callers from missing matching transactions when querying ranges not yet indexed
reviewability: Waiting on author reply to open objections from fjahr
agreement: Concept approval for stopping silent filter lookup failures (maflcko, fjahr)
Unaddressed objection: functional test relies on races and mines excessive blocks (fjahr)
Unaddressed objection: cached index readiness may become outdated during long scans (fjahr)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it stops scanblocks from silently omitting unindexed blocks and returning incomplete matches
Callers can distinguish between finding no matches and failing to scan an unindexed range
